apps.name: Paintrip
apps.summary: A calming watercolor coloring app where you color scenes of cities around the world, one piece at a time. A quiet way to unwind and travel from home — collect passport stamps and pin cities on your world map.

apps.name: Brawl Stars Coloring
apps.tagline: Color and get to know your favorite Brawlers
apps.summary: A fan coloring app where kids color Brawl Stars characters and learn the Brawlers while they play. New pages are added as new Brawlers arrive.

apps.name: Daily Writing Japanese
apps.tagline: Learn Japanese by actually writing it
apps.summary: Learn hiragana, katakana, and the basics by writing them with your own hand. There are plenty of apps for memorizing words or listening — but almost none to learn by writing. So we made one.

apps.name: Daily Writing Hangul
apps.tagline: Learn Korean by actually writing it
apps.summary: A Hangul writing-practice app for learners of Korean. Plenty of vocab and phrase apps exist — but almost none let you learn by writing. So we made one.
